clips.shots: 30%: bald man in sunflower-print shirt (likely Neville, the florist) walking down rustic stone/timber garden steps through lush ferns and pink groundcover, one arm raised to a branch; face not clearly visible. 70%: same garden staircase now empty, clean scenic frame of steps winding through the woodland garden.

30%: low-angle on black SUV front wheel/tire pulling into driveway, solar-panelled house roof and flowering shrub behind. 70%: clean wide of the grey house exterior with large solar array on roof, front porch, shrubs in bloom - strong establishing frame.

30%: black SUV parked on rural road, driver door open (someone getting in/out just off frame), green treeline behind. 70%: front three-quarter of the SUV, door closing/closed, headlight and grille in frame.

30%: tight close-up of hanging basket bursting with magenta petunias and yellow daisies against stone wall. 70%: wider - porch steps with white railing, hanging basket foreground sharp, second urn of petunias on stone landing behind.

30% and 70%: close-up of driftwood owl sculpture hanging beside a white porch swing chain, grey clapboard siding and window behind; slight reframe between frames, otherwise static quirky porch detail.

30%: chalkboard sign on porch wall reading '2026 - imagine with all your mind, believe with all your heart, achieve with all your might, and you will change the world'. 70%: slow pull-back/tilt revealing small bird figurines on the shelf below the chalkboard.
30% and 70%: large pale-pink rhododendron bush in full (slightly past-peak) bloom filling lower frame, bright green maple canopy behind; gentle drift between frames.

30%: porch tableau - two white rocking chairs, side table with bird figurines, chalkboard sign, wicker table; coral begonias soft in foreground right. 70%: rack focus completed - begonias now sharp in foreground, porch soft behind. Nice focus-pull B-roll.

30%: stone garden path descending through birches, ferns and hostas toward the lake and house, path lights along edge - lovely scenic frame. 70%: completely defocused green blur (mid rack-focus/transition) - not usable at this point in the clip.

30%: rustic chiminea/outdoor fireplace surrounded by stacked birch firewood and hostas, shot through birch trunks. 70%: reframed - chiminea silhouette against calm lake with wooden dock and pontoon boat behind. Two distinct usable frames.

30%: close-up of weathered brown birdhouse with black roof, maple leaves foreground. 70%: fairy-garden vignette on a tree stump - garden gnome, two porcelain lady figurines beside the little house. Charming whimsy detail.

30%: purple rhododendron blooms close-up, somewhat dark/underexposed in shade. 70%: wider - the grey two-storey house seen through birch trunks with purple rhodo blooms soft in right foreground. 70% frame is the keeper.

30%: wide of calm lake with yellow floating water-slide platform mid-frame, treed shoreline, edge of pontoon boat right. 70%: covered pontoon boat moored at the aluminum/wood dock, lake and far shore behind.

30% and 70%: lakefront reverse - the house and lawn seen from the shoreline across shallow water, overturned dinghies on the bank, stone beach foreground, reflections in water; slow drift between frames. Strong establishing alternative.
30% and 70%: empty green hammock slung between birch trunks amid ferns and hostas; near-static, minor drift.
30% and 70%: rear/lakeside elevation of the grey house - upper balcony with glass railing, string lights swooping across the lower patio, cedar and birch framing; slight push between frames.
30% and 70%: interior - entry hallway looking toward white front door with sidelights, wooden bookshelf left, console table with lamp, window seat right; slow push in. Good arrival-interior bridge.
30%: hallway console - lit lamp, gilt-framed landscape painting, anniversary clock, small bronze bust; frame slightly canted (camera settling). 70%: same, level and settled. Very short clip (2.8s).
30% and 70%: close-up of small bronze bust (figure in plumed hat), gilt picture frame edge above; dim/moody low-light interior detail, slight reframe between frames.
30% and 70%: two frosted seagull decals on a mirror/window pane beside an embossed leather book spine, warm lamp glow bokeh behind; static interior detail.

30%: sunlit front steps of a white house - stone stairs, white railings, matching urns of pink petunias either side. 70%: tilted up to the front door flanked by two tall cedars. Bright, clean second-location exterior/arrival.
30% and 70%: antique pendulum wall clock on deep-red wall, pillar candles on mantel edge left, lamp and window soft right; slight reframe/widen between frames. Classic time-passing cutaway.
30% and 70%: black metal compass-rose sign hanging in a window reading 'WELCOME TO THE LAKE' with anchor motif, backlit by soft trees; near-static.

30%: hero close-up of spalted-maple ukulele with colourful Aztec-pattern strap resting on burgundy leather couch, strings and rosette sharp. 70%: pulled wider - full ukulele propped on the couch arm, living-room rehearsal space soft behind. The key instrument shot of the day.

30% and 70% (identical - clip is only 0.5s): wooden wall-mounted dinner bell left, 'EAT DRINK & be merry' sign through doorway. Frame is clean but the clip is a half-second fragment - too short to cut with; B-35 covers the same setup.
30% and 70%: same setup as B-33 at full length - antique wooden bracket with brass dinner bell, doorway to kitchen with 'EAT DRINK & be merry' sign; gentle drift between frames.
30% and 70%: sunny perennial garden bed - purple Siberian irises and white irises foreground, pink flowering crabapple tree and blue sky behind; light breeze movement between frames.

30% and 70%: wide garden composition - white house with double balconies left, ornate iron garden bench mid-frame, iris bed foreground, glimpse of lake between trees; slow drift. Excellent location-establishing beauty shot.
30% and 70% (identical - clip is only 0.5s): close-up of two blue Siberian iris blooms. Pretty frame but a half-second fragment; B-40 covers the same subject.
30% and 70%: cluster of blue Siberian irises among tall green blades, second bloom lower right; breeze movement, sunlit.
30% and 70%: macro-ish close-up of single yellow daylily with buds, blue irises as soft bokeh behind; gentle sway between frames. Strong florist-thematic cutaway.
